stages.goal: Assess only media-efficiency and budget-allocation evidence needed for the 7-day plan. Record a concise provisional contribution to shared state.
Assess only stockout, transfer, and replenishment constraints relevant to the same 7-day plan. Read earlier shared state and record a concise provisional contribution.
Assess contribution, margin, cash, and downside constraints using the same overall task and current shared state. Record a concise provisional contribution.

Integrate the recorded stage contributions into one executable 7-day promotion and inventory plan. Preserve uncertainty/provenance. Finalize the plan; if a later environment event arrives, handle it under the same task rather than creating new stages.

scientific_boundary: This is a minimal R7 structured/system-owned-routing condition. It fixes stage order and executable action surface but does not declare the condition safer or better than Free Routing. It is not a production workflow framework.
